sn35.20:1.1: “Monks, whoever delights in forms delights in stress.
sn35.20:1.2: Whoever delights in stress is not released from stress, I tell you. “Whoever delights in sounds delights in stress… “Whoever delights in aromas delights in stress… “Whoever delights in flavors delights in stress…
sn35.20:1.6: “Whoever delights in tactile sensations delights in stress…
sn35.20:1.8: “Monks, whoever delights in ideas delights in stress. Whoever delights in stress is not released from stress, I tell you.
